description: T-2324: what happens to a table and its structured references when insert_column inserts a column at D, just right of the table. Table Sales on S!B3:C7 (header B3:C3 Region/Qty, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8); sheet F holds A1 =SUM(Sales[Qty]), A2 =ROWS(Sales), A3 =ROWS(Sales[#All]), A4 =ROW(Sales[#Headers]), A5 FORMULATEXT(A1), A6 =SUM(S!C4:C7) (a plain range for comparison), A7 FORMULATEXT(A6), A8 =COUNTA(Sales[Region]), A9 FORMULATEXT(A8), A10 =COLUMNS(Sales), A11 =COLUMN(Sales[Qty]), A12 FORMULATEXT(A11).
